blocks.html: Except as specified by Sections 3301.9.1 through 3301.9.6 or as otherwise authorized by law, no sign, information, pictorial representation, or any business or advertising message shall be posted on any construction or demolition equipment or temporary construction installation, including but not limited to, protective structures.
